rows.ARS:
Pink blend Floribunda.
Registration name: MEIlasso
Exhibition name: Cocorico ® (floribunda, Meilland before 1987)
rows.Bloom: Pink blend. None to mild fragrance. up to 15 petals. In large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 30" to 6'7" (75 to 200cm). Width: 4' to 5' (120 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents: Australia - Application No: 1994/209 on 1994 VIEW PBR PATENT
